name: B7·2 Live Rate Feed & Store Intelligence — metal-rate API + footfall counting + AR try-on analytics (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step (paid APIs / hardware involved)
**A. Live metal-rate feed (paid API):**
1. Pick a provider: **metals.dev** (free tier ~100 req/mo, then paid), **goldapi.io** (~$10+/mo), or a local bullion-dealer feed. Get API key → variable **METALS_API_KEY** (URL in the node matches metals.dev — swap URL if using goldapi).
2. Runs 09:00 & 14:00 → converts USD/oz → ₹/gram 24K & 22K (× purity 0.916, + local premium % variable **LOCAL_PREMIUM_PCT**, default 2) → writes today's row into the **Rates** tab.
3. EVERYTHING downstream (Suite calculator, rate-card poster B2·1, threshold alerts B3·1) now updates automatically — zero manual rate entry.

**B. Footfall counting (hardware webhook):**
• Any people-counter camera (Hikvision/CP-Plus with line-crossing) or door sensor that can hit a URL → point it at `footfall-in` (fire one POST per entry). Even a ₹1,500 ESP32 IR sensor works.
• Rows land in **Footfall** tab; 21:00 daily → footfall vs enquiries vs sales conversion summary.

**C. AR try-on analytics:**
• In your try-on page/app, on each try-on event send POST to `tryon-event` {design, action:'tryon'|'share'|'enquire'}.
• Weekly (Sun 20:00) → most-tried designs report → what to stock & post more of.

## 🔧 FIX
• Rate looks off → check LOCAL_PREMIUM_PCT and the troy-ounce→gram conversion (31.1035) in the code node.
• Footfall double-counting → debounce at the sensor, or dedupe window in 'Log entry'.
